prompt_md: What's the greatest number of Friday the 13ths that can fall in a single calendar year?
prompt_short: Most Friday the 13ths possible in one year?
hint_md: Months whose 13ths share a weekday must start on the same weekday.
explain_intuition_md: A month's 13th is a Friday exactly when the month starts on a Sunday. In an ordinary year, February, March and November all start on the same weekday, so a year beginning on a Thursday gets three. No weekday is shared by the starts of four months, in leap years either.
explain_math_md: Weekday shift of each month's first day (common year, mod $7$): $0,3,3,6,1,4,6,2,5,0,3,5$. The most repeated value, $3$, appears $3$ times; in leap years the max is also $3$.
